claim: Saturn signifies the first male child and the father.
quote: सैन के आगे लिखिए फर्स्ट मेल चाइल्ड और फादर
formula: Saturn = first male child; Saturn = father
steps: Assign first male child to Saturn
Assign father to Saturn

claim: The Karma Alignment Technique is based on the Bhrigu Nandi Nadi technique.
quote: जो कर्म अलाइन मेंट टेक्निक है इसका जो बेस है ट इ वगु नंदी टेक्निक है

claim: In Bhrigu Nandi Nadi, the Saturn-Moon-Rahu combination indicates a person who will earn money by unethical means, ignoring moral principles.
quote: सैटर्न मून राहु कॉमिनेशन के लिए यह भी कहा गया है कि यह व्यक्ति जो है यह हर नैतिक अनैतिक विषय को परे रखकर पैसा कमाने के बारे में सोचेगा

claim: In the Karma Alignment Technique, the Saturn-Moon-Rahu combination can be reinterpreted as travel blogging and food blogging, because Saturn signifies karma, Moon signifies food and travel, and Rahu signifies social media activity.
quote: ट्रेवल ब्लॉगिंग और फूड ब्लॉगिंग दोनों को दिखा रहा है क्यों क्योंकि शनि कर्म कारक हो गया चंद्रमा जो है वह खानपान का कारक है और ट्रैवल का भी कारक और राहु हर वो एक्टिविटी है जो हम सोशल मीडिया पर कर रहे हैं
steps: Identify Saturn as the significator of karma (action).
Identify Moon as the significator of food and travel.
Identify Rahu as the significator of social media activity.
Combine these significations to interpret the Saturn-Moon-Rahu combination as indicating travel blogging and food blogging.
examples: Travel bloggers and food bloggers often have the Saturn-Moon-Rahu combination in their charts.

claim: If a person's Mercury and Ketu are conjunct or in transit together, studying astrology is beneficial because it improves intellect and awakens intelligence; if the person is in business, it also benefits the business because Mercury represents business and Ketu represents occult/spiritual subjects.
quote: अगर किसी का बुध और केतु यानी कि मरकरी और केतु कंज है या ट्रान में है तो उस व्यक्ति के लिए एस्ट्रोलॉजी पढ इसलिए अच्छा रहेगा क्योंकि यह उसके इंटेलेक्ट को इंप्रूव करेगा यह उसकी बुद्धि को जागृत करेगा और यदि वह किसी व्यापारिक गतिविधि में है तो उसके व्यापार को भी इससे लाभ होगा क्योंकि मरकरी व्यापार को रिप्रेजेंट करता है केतु जो है वो ओ कल्ट रिलेटेड सब्जेक्ट आध्यात्मिक विषय को रिप्रेजेंट कर रहा है
steps: Check if Mercury (Budh) and Ketu are conjunct (yuti) or in transit together.
If yes, astrology study is favorable.
If the person is in business, business also benefits.
examples: Mercury and Ketu conjunction or transit

claim: The combination of Mercury and Ketu produces different results depending on the ascendant and house placement; for example, for a Leo ascendant with Mercury in the 1st house and Ketu in the 5th house, the combination is formed, while for a Leo ascendant with Mercury in the 6th house and Ketu in the 10th house, it is a different combination.
quote: अगर तुम लगन के व्यक्ति हो तुम्हारा बुध प्रथम भाव में है और केतु फिफ्थ हाउस में है तो यह कॉमिनेशन तुम्हारे लिए बन गया मैं सिंह लगन का व्यक्ति हूं मेरा बुध छठे घर में है केतु मेरा दशम भाव में है तो यह एक अलग कॉमिनेशन बन गया
steps: Identify the ascendant (lagna).
Note the house placement of Mercury and Ketu.
The combination's effect varies by ascendant and house placement.
examples: Leo ascendant: Mercury in 1st house and Ketu in 5th house
Leo ascendant: Mercury in 6th house and Ketu in 10th house

claim: There are four triangles (trikonas): the first is the Dharma Trikona (1st, 5th, 9th houses) which informs about personality, knowledge, and the right path to follow in life; the second is the Moksha Trikona (4th, 8th, 12th houses) which indicates actions that lead to liberation (mukti).
quote: देखो हमें चार त्रिकोण मिले उन चार त्रिकोण में कौन है पहला है धर्म त्रिकोण जो हमें हमारी पर्सनालिटी के बारे में अवगत कराता है हमारे लिए ज्ञानवर्धक कौन सी चीजें हैं उसके बारे में अवगत कराता है हमें लाइफ में धर्म क्या फॉलो करना है राइच पाथ क्या फलो करना उसके बारे में अवगत कराता है तो ये किस त्रिकोण का कार्य हो गया एक पान का फिर एक त्रिकोण आ गया हमारा चा आ 12 वाला मोक्ष त्रिकोण मोक्ष त्रिकोण वाला जो त्रिकोण है वो हमें किस तरफ लेकर जा रहा है वो हमें यह बता रहा है कि वो कौन से कार्य ऐसे हैं जो हमें जीवन में मुक्ति की तरफ लेकर जाएंगे
steps: Identify the four trikonas.
Dharma Trikona: 1st, 5th, 9th houses — personality, knowledge, right path.
Moksha Trikona: 4th, 8th, 12th houses — liberation.

claim: If the combination in the 4th, 8th, and 12th houses (Moksha Trikona) is properly utilized, it gives freedom and liberation (mukti) while alive.
quote: चार आ 12 में जो कॉमिनेशन काम करेगा वह कॉमिनेशन यदि सुचारू रूप से कार्य में ले लिया जाए तो यह आपको फ्रीडम दे देगा आपको फ्री कर देगा और आपको वो मुक्ति का एहसास जीते जी करा देगा
steps: Identify the combination in the 4th, 8th, and 12th houses.
If utilized properly, it grants freedom and liberation in life.

quote: if you see from the khal purush the second lord goes into sixth house so you know the kuttumba bhav goes into dispute it shows family disputes

quote: and then the seventh lord is twelfth from itself loss of marriage

quote: it can make you overly practical it can make you fearful of relationship fearful of marriage

quote: if mass is associated with debilitated venus it can increase the desire the lust in the body and it can never allow you to settle in a relationship

quote: when you have Venus in the sixth house you know it strongly can indicate somebody who's a veterinarian first of all who's has love for the animals

quote: it also represents working with agreements working with contracts so a lawyer

claim: During Sun Mahadasha, if the Sun is weak or afflicted, the native may experience health issues such as eye problems, cataract, or need for surgery.
quote: You may have to undergo an ID operation, loss of eyesight or problems related to it, cataract or any other diseases can occur under the condition of the Sun.

claim: If the Sun is linked to the second and twelfth house, it indicates significant property matters.
quote: Therefore, if the Sun is linked to the second and twelfth house, then it is a very big property for it

claim: If the Moon at birth is in Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, or Uttara Bhadrapada nakshatra, the native starts life with a Sun mahadasha of about 6 years (or 3-4 years depending on the Moon's degree).
quote: if your moon was in utaka nakhatra utra pelguni and utra ashida uttra ashila nakhatra if you were born in any one of these three constellations your your life started with a six-year time period of sun maybe four maybe three depending upon what degree moon was in
formula: Sun mahadasha duration = 6 years, adjusted by Moon's position in the nakshatra
steps: Determine the Moon's nakshatra at birth.
If Moon is in Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, or Uttara Bhadrapada, the first mahadasha is Sun.
The duration is approximately 6 years, but may be 3-4 years depending on the Moon's degree within the nakshatra.

claim: During Moon Mahadasha, there is a strong inner urge to change residence, and the living place is likely to change.
quote: You will get that you will have a great eagerness from within to change your house and you will try to live in the house you are living in and you will try, that means you will execute it for maximum time and change your house, so the place of your house, the living place where you live, is quite probable to change under the condition of the Moon

claim: If the Moon is not well placed, a heavy loan may be involved in changing residence, and later eviction from the same house can occur.
quote: if the Moon is not in a very well place then a very heavy loan can be involved in it and later you will be evicted from the same house

claim: If the Moon is not in a welfare placement, one may be forced to leave their house despite wanting to stay with parents.
quote: if the Moon is not in welfare then it is possible that you want to stay in your house, want to live with your parents and you have to leave your house due to compulsion

claim: If the Moon is well placed, one may move to a good house with a big open and united environment and be happy there.
quote: if it is a good placement then you will go to a very good house where there will be a big open and big united environment where you will like to live, you can be happy in such a house

claim: Mars Mahadasha lasts for a total of seven years.
quote: मंगल की महादशा कुल सात वर्षों के लिए होती है।

claim: If Mars is in its exaltation sign Capricorn, own sign Scorpio or Aries, or in kendra or trikona houses with benefic aspects, the Mahadasha gives unprecedented progress, acquisition of land and vehicles, and increase in valor, decision-making, and leadership.
quote: यदि कुंडली में मंगल उच्च राशि मकर में हो, स्वराशि, वृश्चिक या मेष में हो या केंद्र या त्रिकोण के भावों में शुभ दृष्टियों से युक्त हो तो यह महादशा जीवन में अभूतपूर्व उन्नति, भूमि, वाहन की प्राप्ति, पराक्रम, निर्णय क्षमता और नेतृत्व में वृद्धि देती है।

claim: If Mars is in its debilitation sign Cancer, or in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, and is afflicted by Rahu, Saturn, or Ketu, the Mahadasha can cause quarrels, legal disputes, accidents, blood-related problems, anger, violence, and mental unrest.
quote: परंतु यदि मंगल नीच राशि कर्क में हो या छठे, आठवें, 12वें भाव में होकर राहु, शनि या केतु से पीड़ित हो तो यही महादशा, झगड़े, कानूनी विवाद, दुर्घटनाएं, रक्त संबंधित समस्याएं, क्रोध, हिंसा और मानसिक अशांति का कारण भी बन सकती हैं।

claim: Malefics like Mars, Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu in the third house make a person insensitive and reactive.
quote: when there are malefics like Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu such malefics even transit you see it becomes very straightforward I don't care who is doing what I am done with all these people and because of that a person becomes insensitive

claim: Benefics in the third house make a person sensitive and enhance creativity.
quote: benefits make a person sensitive

claim: Jupiter Mahadasha is rarely good for Capricorn ascendant because Jupiter is the lord of the 12th house for Capricorn.
quote: But for those people like Capricorn ascendant, Jupiter Mahadasha is rarely good because it is the lord of the 12th house.

claim: During Jupiter Mahadasha, if Jupiter is well placed, it multiplies positive outcomes; if badly placed, it multiplies negative outcomes.
quote: Guru is a multiplier. If it is good then we are going to multiply the good. If it is bad then he is going to multiply the bad also.
